description: Latest headlines from the Corvus Intel news corpus that feeds Apprised.news: the same list as the site's breaking ticker and Breaking view (https://apprised.news/?view=breaking), newest first. The headlines are third-party reporting collected automatically (each has its outlet and original URL); Apprised.news did not write or verify them. With no arguments: the last 3 hours, 15 items. minutes widens or narrows the window; query keeps only items matching any comma-separated keyword (a * is a wildcard), searched over the whole window.

limit.description: Most headlines to return (1 to 50, default 15).

minutes.description: Window in minutes (5 to 43200). Default: the ticker window, the last 3 hours.

query.description: Comma-separated keywords, any of which may match headline, outlet, region or category, e.g. "iran, hormuz" or "tariff*".

name: get_breaking_news
